entries.title: Job 36:1
segments: ¶Elihu also proceeded, and said,

entries.title: Job 36:2
segments: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that [I have] yet to speak on God's behalf. {I have...: Heb. there are yet words for God}

words.text: thee that [I have] yet to speak
behalf. {I have...: Heb. there are yet words for God}

entries.title: Job 36:3
segments: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

entries.title: Job 36:4
segments: For truly my words [shall] not [be] false: he that is perfect in knowledge [is] with thee.

entries.title: Job 36:5
segments: ¶Behold, God [is] mighty, and despiseth not [any: he is] mighty in strength [and] wisdom. {wisdom: Heb. heart}

entries.title: Job 36:6
segments: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor. {poor: or, afflicted}

entries.title: Job 36:7
segments: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings [are they] on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.

entries.title: Job 36:8
segments: And if [they be] bound in fetters, [and] be holden in cords of affliction;

entries.title: Job 36:9
segments: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.

entries.title: Job 36:10
segments: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.

entries.title: Job 36:11
segments: If they obey and serve [him], they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

entries.title: Job 36:12
segments: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge. {perish: Heb. pass away}

entries.title: Job 36:13
segments: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.

entries.title: Job 36:14
segments: They die in youth, and their life [is] among the unclean. {They...: Heb. Their soul dieth} {unclean: or, sodomites}

words.text: . {They...: Heb. Their soul dieth} {unclean: or, sodomites}

entries.title: Job 36:15
segments: ¶He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression. {poor: or, afflicted}

entries.title: Job 36:16
segments: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait [into] a broad place, where [there is] no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table [should be] full of fatness. {that...: Heb. the rest of thy table}

words.text: Even so would he have removed
; and that which should be set
. {that...: Heb. the rest of thy table}

entries.title: Job 36:17
segments: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold [on thee]. {take...: or, should uphold thee}

entries.title: Job 36:18
segments: Because [there is] wrath, [beware] lest he take thee away with [his] stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee. {deliver...: Heb. turn thee aside}

entries.title: Job 36:19
segments: Will he esteem thy riches? [no], not gold, nor all the forces of strength.

entries.title: Job 36:20
segments: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.

entries.title: Job 36:21
segments: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

entries.title: Job 36:22
segments: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?

entries.title: Job 36:23
segments: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?

entries.title: Job 36:24
segments: ¶Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.

entries.title: Job 36:25
segments: Every man may see it; man may behold [it] afar off.

entries.title: Job 36:26
segments: Behold, God [is] great, and we know [him] not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.

entries.title: Job 36:27
segments: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:

entries.title: Job 36:28
segments: Which the clouds do drop [and] distil upon man abundantly.

entries.title: Job 36:29
segments: Also can [any] understand the spreadings of the clouds, [or] the noise of his tabernacle?

entries.title: Job 36:30
segments: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea. {bottom: Heb. roots}

entries.title: Job 36:31
segments: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.

entries.title: Job 36:32
segments: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it [not to shine] by [the cloud] that cometh betwixt.

words.text: it [not to shine] by [the cloud] that cometh betwixt

entries.title: Job 36:33
segments: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour. {the vapour: Heb. that which goeth up}

words.text: . {the vapour: Heb. that which goeth up}
